56495.en: In a triangle ABC, the A-mixtilinear incircle touches its circumcircircle and sides AC, AB at A', A_{b}, A_{c}, respectively. BC is cut by lines A'A_{b} and A'A_{c} at A'_{b} and A'_{c}, respectively; B'_{c}, B'_{a}, C'_{a}, C'_{b} are defined cyclically. Then these six points A'_{b}, A'_{c}, B'_{c}, B'_{a}, C'_{a}, C'_{b} lie on conic. (Tran Viet Hung, `Romantics of Geometry 13125 <https://www.facebook.com/groups/parmenides52/permalink/6490446121069039/>`__)
no: The described conic has equation Σ[b*c*(b^2*c^2*(b+c)*(-a+b+c)^2*x^2-a^3*(a+b-c)*(a-b+c)*(a^2+(b+c)*a+2*b*c)*y*z)]=0, center X_56495 and perspector X_56496. Note: the indicated six points are not coconic for mixtilinear excircles. (César Lozada, Aug. 17, 2023)
